title: The Unexpected Yearbook
author: Cyrus Ashgrove
blurb: Petra Villalobos, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
